channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Houston to receive $9 million for public transit improvements ahead of World Cup
item.description: The U.S. Department of Transportation announced a $100 million investment across several cities hosting World Cup matches this summer.

item.title: Trump fires Kristi Noem as DHS chief, names Sen. Markwayne Mullin to replace her
item.description: Stepping in as acting secretary is GOP Sen. Markwayne Mullin of Oklahoma who Trump said had "Wisdom and Courage required to Advance our America First Agenda."

item.title: Live from the rodeo (March 5, 2026)
item.description: On Thursday's show: We broadcast live from the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo where we talk about the annual celebration of western culture and how the need for water will affect Texas agriculture in the future. Plus, we go shopping for western wear, and we take an inside look at the annual calf scramble.

item.title: Houston-area gas prices have risen 30 cents since U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran
item.description: According to AAA, the highest gas prices ever recorded in Houston were $4.68 per gallon of regular unleaded and $5.24 per gallon of diesel during March 2022 — shortly after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.

item.title: Houston controller says city is spending more on electricity bills
item.description: The city signed an electricity contract before the 2021 winter freeze, temporarily shielding it from higher prices in the aftermath of the storm. Its costs are now going up.

item.title: Hello Houston – LIVE at the Houston Rodeo (March 5, 2026)
item.description: Today: We broadcast the show from the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo, where we learn all about what’s happening at Houston’s largest annual event.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (March 5, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters, we have – The Commuter Cut – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Six Flags to sell Schlitterbahn Galveston and six other parks in $331M deal
item.description: A Spokesperson for EPR Properties said the property is expected to stay a water park.

item.title: Texas sees record voter turnout in primaries led by Democratic voters
item.description: Democratic voters outnumbered Republicans at polls on Election day by more than 4%, based on unofficial numbers from the Texas Secretary of State.
